Leader

You turn to your companions and give them a reason to move together.

Rules

Agreed: minimum 0 in Guile, Fortitude; HP contribution +4. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Influence, Guard, Arms, Scholarship.

Discipline pricing: Home: Influence, Guard. Adjacent: Arms, Scholarship. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.935e12b7e7b17d26.JournalEntryPage.99ff7e21e2963030]{Follow My Signal} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.bc490dac0396479c.JournalEntryPage.b7681c3b598094cc]{Lead the Step} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0c9e4117830df53a.JournalEntryPage.6fdd2243127b30dd]{Stand Together}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b2c970de523d19e4.JournalEntryPage.65f59324cfeaee8e]{Press the Opening} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.45d72101e9a365bb.JournalEntryPage.4b310c82cbe1039a]{Orderly Withdrawal} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3343b6a6d95daa0c.JournalEntryPage.c448427b1f865df4]{Hold Your Nerve}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.ad14783ab3fbc056.JournalEntryPage.f1b7d6ce25786b72]{Coordinated Rush} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.29d0f502dd7f3598.JournalEntryPage.51027fd52037b955]{Refuse the Rout} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.93f9a185ce3a6c4a.JournalEntryPage.ef95ef20579fd973]{Watch the Rear}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Signal two allies, withdraw together, or hold a paired line. - Level 3: Order a retreat, call a basic strike, or interrupt panic and shock. - Level 7: Coordinate a rush, rally a group, or cover an ally's escape.

Starting coin contribution: +6 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
